Package org.micromanager.display

package org.micromanager.display
This package contains classes related to Micro-Manager's display windows, which are used to show image data and metadata to the user. The primary class for this package is the DisplayWindow class. Events in this package are specific to a single DisplayWindow, and can be subscribed to via DisplayWindow.registerForEvents().
